title: Two papers presented at WMT 2026 (EMNLP co-located)
summary: ɪreːn presents two papers at the Eleventh Conference on Machine Translation (WMT 2026) in Budapest, co-located with EMNLP 2026: one on PANINI rsLoRA dual-script translation and one on cross-script meta-evaluation.

title: Official ɪreːn Research Collaboration Platform Launched
summary: The official web platform and open-science portal for the ɪreːn research initiative is live, consolidating datasets, benchmarks, field tools, and published papers for low-resource languages.

title: Aura System Demonstration Accepted at AACL-IJCNLP 2026
summary: Aura: A Self-Hostable Platform for Human Evaluation of NLG for Under-resourced Languages accepted at the 2026 System Demonstration Track. Interactive trials will be demonstrated live.

title: Which Metric for Which Script? Accepted at WMT 2026 Research Track
summary: Our quantified meta-evaluation evaluating BLEU, chrF++, and LLM-as-a-judge rankings against calibrated human ratings across Meitei Mayek and Bengali scripts accepted in the main WMT research track.

title: Team PANINI Ranked Top in WMT 2026 Low-Resource Indic Shared Task
summary: Our submission ranked among the top translation models on English ↔ Manipuri translation in both native scripts using rsLoRA parameter-efficient fine-tuning and three-stream data synthesis.

title: Scriba Toolkit v1.0 Released for Field Linguistics Audio Elicitation
summary: First public release of Scriba, an offline-first desktop tool enabling field linguists to record, segment, time-align, and transcribe acoustic speech in non-Latin writing systems without cloud dependencies.

title: Manipuri Multi-Speaker Speech Corpus Released on Hugging Face
summary: Released over 25 hours of multi-speaker read speech recordings with dual-script alignments (Meitei Mayek and Bengali script) along with phoneme boundaries on the Hugging Face Hub.

title: IndicEval Benchmark Suite Published on PyPI
summary: Released indic-eval Python package on PyPI, offering standardized metric pipelines for evaluating script-transliterated and agglutinative low-resource South Asian language translations.

title: Dual-Script Alignment Paper Accepted at LREC-COLING 2025
summary: Our comprehensive study on acoustic phoneme alignment and phonetic drift across orthographic shifts accepted at Language Resources and Evaluation Conference (LREC-COLING 2025).

title: Keynote at Northeast Language Technology Forum
summary: Rudali Huidrom delivered an invited keynote on 'Building Language Technology by and for Speaker Communities' at the regional NLP and Speech Symposium in Guwahati, Assam.

title: Linguistic Fieldwork Expedition in Imphal & Bishnupur
summary: Team members conducted an in-depth 3-week field elicitation drive with 30 native speakers, archiving dialectal phonetic variations and historical oral narratives across rural Manipur.

title: CNRS-GETALP & Collaborating Labs Joint Research Grant Awarded
summary: Awarded bilateral research funding supporting multi-institution collaboration between CNRS LIG GETALP (Grenoble, France) and Indian institutes to study extreme low-resource speech technologies.
